description: Search audited built-in and explicitly supplied workspace-local workflow recipes. Recipes are declarative previews and cannot execute arbitrary tools or scripts.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute approved workspace containing recipe_file; required with recipe_file.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive title, description, tag, or ID query.

recipe_file.description: Optional contained JSON file with closed-schema custom recipes.

name: search_workflow_recipes

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.
